description: rpm hooks for Codex CLI. Subset of plugin/hooks/hooks.json — only events Codex actually fires.

hooks.command: bash -c 'script="$1"; shift; roots=(); [ -n "${RPM_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && roots+=("$RPM_PLUGIN_ROOT"); [ -n "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && roots+=("$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT"); [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && roots+=("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"); roots+=("${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache/dppdppd-rpm/rpm/"* "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/.tmp/marketplaces/dppdppd-rpm/.codex"); for root in "${roots[@]}"; do [ -f "$root/hooks/$script" ] && exec bash "$root/hooks/$script"; done; echo "rpm hook not found: $script" >&2; exit 127' rpm-hook session-start-auto.sh
